title: Do not repor trivial narrowing as a change in binder

target.summary: In `update_from_options()`, processing multiple variables can reset `changed` to `False` in the `else` branch when a subsequent variable without a current value matches its declared type. Consequently, the binder can fail to report a change even when an earlier variable's type was updated.
notes: faulty branch overwriting changed even if an earlier variable set it to True
